[Tsuruha Drug](https://www.tsuruha.co.jp/en/), a major Japanese drugstore chain, sells a wide variety of medicines, cosmetics, skin care, daily necessities, baby and pet care products, and groceries including snacks, beverages, and frozen foods. They also carry private-label goods under the brand **Kurashi Rhythm**. [](https://www.tsuruha.co.jp/en/)

- **Medicines & Health**: Over-the-counter drugs, prescription medications (at select locations), first-aid items, vitamins, and health supplements. [](https://shop.tsuruha-g.com/en/1274)

- **Beauty & Skincare**: Japanese cosmetics, facial cleansers, sheet masks, UV care/sunscreens, and hair care products. [](https://livejapan.com/en/in-kansai/in-pref-osaka/in-namba_dotonbori_shinsaibashi/article-a2000855/)

- **Food & Drink**: Bottled water, soft drinks, instant foods, seasonings, snacks, and at some larger or rural branches, fresh foods and frozen meals. [](https://shop.tsuruha-g.com/en/1274)

- **Daily Necessities**

: Detergents, cleaning supplies, paper products (tissues and toilet paper), and household goods.

[](https://shop.tsuruha.co.jp/15801/2683.html)

- **Family & Pet Care**: Baby formula, diapers, baby wipes, and pet food/supplies. [](https://shop.tsuruha-g.com/en/1274)
